query:
UPDATE financial_goals
            SET 
                name = COALESCE($3, name),
                description = COALESCE($4, description),
                target_amount = COALESCE($5, target_amount),
                current_amount = COALESCE($6, current_amount),
                icon = COALESCE($7, icon),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2
